post.description: Explicit generation only; no worker. Each request scans at most 366 local dates and returns at most 100 occurrences. Progress persists atomically. Follow the actor/scope/series/revision/through-bound cursor; retries and concurrent generation cannot duplicate identities. Missed valid occurrences stay PENDING. Occurrence Tasks copy master title/description/priority, unchecked checklist and labels; dueAt is the resolved instant, scheduledDate is series-local date. Files are not copied. Exclusions produce no Task. Changing account timezone never changes series timezone.
